summary: Fun preschool game where kids explore 5 worlds, find sheep, and learn numbers
description:
OBSERVE AND COUNT FROM AGE 3
The sheep have escaped! It’s your turn: with Pango, find them, catch them, gather your flock and bring them back to the pen. In every area, your challenge is simple: find exactly 10 sheep!

Your child counts, recounts, and discovers the meaning of numbers through play.
The experience is calm, intuitive, and without any timer: your child observes, tries, explores freely, and gradually builds logical thinking.

THE PANGO STANDARD
For more than 15 years, Pango has offered smart, colorful, and caring games to over 15 million children around the world.
Pango Sheep continues this tradition: a simple and warm educational game designed for children aged 3 to 6.

WHY DO PARENTS LOVE PANGO SHEEP?
Because it combines the very best:
✔ a calm universe that helps focus attention
✔ simple mechanics that teach counting
✔ free exploration that encourages autonomy and confidence
✔ a tender, positive game adapted to small hands
✔ a healthy alternative to fast and noisy games

Pango Sheep supports preschool children in their early learning.

Interactions are fun and varied: a bath in the river, a roll in the mud, a silly shearing session, a mischievous wolf, a tiny train… and sheep you can dress up and color however you like!
Just enough to spark curiosity.

A 100% SAFE ENVIRONMENT
The app is fully designed for calm and independent use:
no ads, no external links, no hidden purchases.
Integrated parental controls protect the settings.
Everything complies with COPPA/GDPR standards for a smooth, safe, and controlled experience.

OUR COMMITMENT
At Pango, we create games for children with heart and common sense.
Our mission is simple: give children a quiet space to learn, understand, and have fun — without stress or competition.

Need help? We’re always here: pango@studio-pango.com

More information about our creations: www.studio-pango.com

DOWNLOAD PANGO SHEEP… and enjoy the adventure of the cutest shepherd ever! Find them, count them… and off they go, back to the pen!
